mapper.sql: logged_at >= #{from} AND logged_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT client_ip AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM log_access WHERE AND client_ip IS NOT NULL AND client_ip <> '' GROUP BY client_ip ORDER BY value DESC, label ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(referer, '/', 3), '://', -1) AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM log_access WHERE AND referer IS NOT NULL AND referer <> '' GROUP BY label HAVING label IS NOT NULL AND label <> '' ORDER BY value DESC, label ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT client_ip AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM log_access WHERE AND status_code >= 400 AND client_ip IS NOT NULL AND client_ip <> '' GROUP BY client_ip ORDER BY value DESC, label ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT request_uri AS label, COUNT(*) AS value, AVG(response_ms) AS valueExtra FROM log_access WHERE AND response_ms IS NOT NULL AND request_uri IS NOT NULL AND request_uri <> '' GROUP BY request_uri HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minCalls} ORDER BY valueExtra DESC, value DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT request_uri AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM log_access WHERE AND (actor_user_type IS NULL OR actor_user_type = '' OR actor_user_type = 'ANONYMOUS') AND request_uri IS NOT NULL AND request_uri <> '' AND request_uri <> '/' GROUP BY request_uri ORDER BY value DESC, label ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CASE WHEN INSTR(SUBSTRING(request_uri, 2), '/') > 0 THEN CONCAT('/', SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING(request_uri, 2), '/', 2)) ELSE request_uri END AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM log_access WHERE AND request_uri IS NOT NULL AND request_uri LIKE '/%' AND request_uri <> '/' AND status_code < 400 GROUP BY label HAVING label <> '/' ORDER BY value DESC, label ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT user_agent AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM log_access WHERE AND user_agent IS NOT NULL AND user_agent <> '' GROUP BY user_agent ORDER BY value DESC, label ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT client_ip AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT request_uri) AS value FROM log_access WHERE AND client_ip IS NOT NULL AND client_ip <> '' GROUP BY client_ip ORDER BY value DESC, label ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT client_ip AS label, SUM(bytes_sent) AS value, COUNT(*) AS valueExtra FROM log_access WHERE AND bytes_sent IS NOT NULL AND bytes_sent > 0 AND client_ip IS NOT NULL AND client_ip <> '' GROUP BY client_ip ORDER BY value DESC, label ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT request_uri AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM log_access WHERE AND status_code = 404 AND request_uri IS NOT NULL AND request_uri <> '' GROUP BY request_uri ORDER BY value DESC, label ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(original_name, ''), file_id) AS label, COUNT(*) AS value, SUM(size_bytes) AS valueExtra FROM log_file_download WHERE downloaded_at >= #{from} AND downloaded_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND result = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY label ORDER BY value DESC, label ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT actor_login_id AS label, COUNT(*) AS value, COUNT(DISTINCT client_ip) AS valueExtra FROM log_access WHERE AND actor_login_id IS NOT NULL AND actor_login_id <> '' AND (actor_user_type IS NULL OR actor_user_type <> 'ANONYMOUS') GROUP BY actor_login_id ORDER BY value DESC, label ASC LIMIT #{limit}
